document.note: Flow: an issue tracker with a kanban board. Boards are rows of the sidebar, next to the inbox, the sprints and the projects; the board, a grouped list, swimlanes by member, a table of every card or a timeline of due dates shares a split with the chosen card's drawer, or the board's insights. Drag a card to another column, use the drawer's arrows, Alt and the arrows, or right-click it for its menu; double-click it or press Cmd+Enter to open it as a page, Enter to edit it. Cmd+P goes to a card, Cmd+Shift+P runs a command, Cmd+N types a new card, Cmd+F searches, Cmd+Z undoes, Cmd+J switches light and dark, Cmd+L the language, Cmd+, opens the settings, Escape closes the issue page, then clears the filters.

assistant.point.note: Lets the person point at an element of the app for the next message, four at most: the panel steps aside (it is modal), the focus staying where it was, and comes back when they pick or cancel

assistant.pointed.note: When the person picked: the element joins the next message's (once: one already there, or the assistant's own, is forgotten again), and the panel opens on the field

addToCard.note: with: field (checklist, comments or attachments), value, input (the text typed: nothing is added while it is blank)

with.lines: {{map(map(slice(entries(run.arguments ?? {}), 0, 3), {key: join(split(it.key, '\n'), ' '), letters: split(join(split(type(it.value) == 'string' ? it.value : json(it.value), '\n'), ' '), '')}), it.key + ': ' + join(slice(it.letters, 0, 60), '') + (length(it.letters) > 60 ? '…' : ''))}}
